To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The mass media play an important role in shaping the ways in which people express their feelings.
the mass media, in this case a television program, can be a powerful force in shaping emotional display, and that this is done through a combination of globalizing and localizing forces.

the mass media can shape emotional expression by (a) framing emotional displays in ways which align their meanings with cultural ideologies and values and (b) providing models of emotional expression that people might imitate.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of emotion in the process of globalization and localization.
the ways in which the global reality television format trade and local culture interact in the production of mass-mediated emotional performances.
the ways in which mass media shape and are shaped by local cultural values and ideologies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mass media, in this case reality television, is a key factor that influences the localization of emotional expression.
this study has shown how mass media and globalization are shaping the way people express emotions in China, and how local culture and values are being incorporated into globally circulating forms.
the mass media, through the reality television program China’s next top model, have been successful in localizing emotional displays.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
globalization is not a process that is simply imposed upon local cultures, but is a process that is jointly constructed by local cultures and global media.
we have shown that the emotional performances on the show are not just the product of a globally circulating format.
the emotional display is not just a product of individual emotions, but a result of social and cultural contexts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mass media is an underexplored but important site for studying the localization of emotional expression in global contexts.
the globalization of emotional display is a complex process in which global formats and cultural values are negotiated in the context of local audience reception.
emotional performances are shaped by both global formats and local ideologies and cultural practices.
